answer: The harbor counter is kept in sonnet and river makes public each reset. An hostile operator as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 37 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 37 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That is 975 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
